description: Update a lead (partial — only provided fields change; empty values are NOT cleared). To blank a column, list it in clear_fields.

ad_click_id.description: The platform's click id (fbclid, gclid, li_fat_id, msclkid, epik, ttclid, oppref). Without it a report back can only be matched on the hashed e-mail.

ad_external_id.description: The platform's own id for this submission (Meta leadgen_id, LinkedIn response id, Google lead_id). Duplicate guard only — the click id belongs in ad_click_id.

ad_received_at.description: When the platform recorded the click/submission (ISO). Used to build Meta's fbc value.

ad_source.description: Advertising platform the lead came from: meta | linkedin | google_ads | microsoft_ads | pinterest | tiktok | openai_ads. Empty means not from advertising.

best_email.description: Preferred e-mail address to reach the lead

best_phone.description: Preferred phone number to reach the lead; used before phone when dialing

clear_fields.description: Column names to set to NULL (opt-in clear).

custom.description: Lead custom field values { key: value } set in the same call (list_custom_fields entity 'leads'); null clears. Checked like set_custom_values.

lead_id.description: ID of the lead to change

next_action.description: Text of the next planned action

referral_comment.description: Free-text note on the referral arrangement.

referral_link.description: Link for who/what referred this lead — e.g. a URL, or the in-app link to the referring lead.

referral_share_type.description: 'revenue' or 'profit' — what the agreed share is a percentage of.

name: update_lead
